When someone is medically unsafe to drive due to neurological symptoms and high temperature, the surgery should provide access to clinical care, not redirect to urgent care without alternatives. Elderly or vulnerable people would not even be able to fill in the form fast enough to compete for the limited appointments.

This is not how primary care should operate. Patients deserve safe, timely access to medical assessment — not a system where you have to fight for care at 8:00am and still be ignored. Truly disappointing and concerning.

Stars speaking them selfs! That clinic should be closed.
